The people behind it

Who We Are

I’m Emanuel, 31, from Italy. Son is 30, from Vietnam. We live in Sweden and grew up in families where food was everything: Sunday pasta, street noodles, night-market snacks and long dinners with too much talking.

On FreakinFood, we mix our traditions and our new Scandinavian life: simple recipes, comfort food, drinks for slow evenings and honest reviews of places we try.

EmanuelItaly → Sweden · Chef
SonVietnam → Sweden · Coffee taster

About our pictures

All recipe and drink images on FreakinFood are created in an animated, illustration-style with AI to match our playful vibe.

For restaurant reviews, we always use real photos we take ourselves, so you see exactly what arrives at the table.
